description: Implement three external AI provider adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) with real API integrations, streaming support, API key validation, error mapping, and secure credential storage via existing CredentialStore. Register providers in IntelligenceRegistry with capability metadata, benchmark scores, cost profiles, and latency profiles. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 and FEAT-003.
steps: 1. Create c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\core\external\providers\ProviderTypes.ts defining shared interfaces: AIProviderAdapter with methods (generateStream, validateApiKey, getCost, getLatency), StreamChunk { text: string, done: boolean }, ProviderError { code: string, message: string, retryable: boolean }, ProviderConfig { apiKey: string, model: string }, TokenUsage { inputTokens: number, outputTokens: number }.

2. Create c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\core\external\providers\OpenAIProvider.ts extending BaseExternalProvider. Implement id='openai_provider', name='OpenAI', type='cloud_model'. Capabilities: ['TEXT_GENERATION', 'REASONING', 'DEEP_REASONING', 'CODING', 'VISION', 'FUNCTION_CALLING', 'STRUCTURED_OUTPUT']. Support models: gpt-4, gpt-4o, o1-preview. Method generateStream(input: string, model: string): AsyncGenerator<StreamChunk> uses fetch with SSE parsing. Method validateApiKey(key: string): Promise<boolean> calls https://api.openai.com/v1/models with Authorization Bearer. Store/retrieve keys via credentialStore.retrieve<{apiKey: string}>('openai_provider'). Map API errors to ProviderError with codes: INVALID_KEY, RATE_LIMIT, NETWORK_ERROR, TIMEOUT. Use AbortController for cancellation.

3. Create c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\core\external\providers\AnthropicProvider.ts extending BaseExternalProvider. Implement id='anthropic_provider', name='Anthropic Claude', type='cloud_model'. Capabilities: ['TEXT_GENERATION', 'REASONING', 'DEEP_REASONING', 'CODING', 'VISION', 'LONG_CONTEXT']. Support models: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, claude-3-opus-20240229. Method generateStream uses https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with x-api-key header and streaming. Validate via /v1/messages test call. Store keys via credentialStore with service ID 'anthropic_provider'. Map errors similarly.

4. Create c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\core\external\providers\GoogleGeminiProvider.ts extending BaseExternalProvider. Implement id='google_gemini_provider', name='Google Gemini', type='cloud_model'. Capabilities: ['TEXT_GENERATION', 'REASONING', 'CODING', 'VISION', 'LONG_CONTEXT']. Support models: gemini-1.5-pro, gemini-1.5-flash. Use https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?key={apiKey} for streaming. Validate via models list endpoint. Store keys with service ID 'google_gemini_provider'.

5. Update c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\core\external\providers\index.ts to export { OpenAIProvider, AnthropicProvider, GoogleGeminiProvider, AIProviderAdapter, StreamChunk, ProviderError, ProviderConfig, TokenUsage } from './ProviderTypes', './OpenAIProvider', './AnthropicProvider', './GoogleGeminiProvider'. Check if ExternalProviderRegistry export exists; if not, export it.

6. Extend c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\intelligence\registry\IntelligenceRegistry.ts: add registerExternalProvider(config: { id: string, name: string, type: 'CLOUD_MODEL', capabilities: ProviderCapability[], costProfile: CostProfile, latencyProfile: LatencyProfile, benchmarkScores: Record<string, number> }): void method that creates an IntelligenceProviderEntry with state='INACTIVE' and calls this.registerProvider(entry). Add getProvidersByRequirement(requirements: TaskRequirements): IntelligenceProviderEntry[] method that filters active providers by required capabilities and reasoning level.

7. In IntelligenceRegistry.registerBuiltInProviders(), after registering existing providers, call this.registerExternalProvider three times for OpenAI (GPT-4o: MMLU 88.7, HumanEval 90.2, inputCostPer1kTokens: 0.0025, outputCostPer1kTokens: 0.01, averageMs: 1200, p50Ms: 1000), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet: MMLU 88.3, HumanEval 92.0, inputCostPer1kTokens: 0.003, outputCostPer1kTokens: 0.015, averageMs: 1400, p50Ms: 1100), Google Gemini (Gemini 1.5 Pro: MMLU 85.9, HumanEval 84.1, inputCostPer1kTokens: 0.00125, outputCostPer1kTokens: 0.005, averageMs: 1300, p50Ms: 1050). Use existing ProviderCapability interface and CostProfile/LatencyProfile from intelligence types.

8. Extend c:\Users\uk\Pictures\Saturday-2\src\services\container.ts: import { OpenAIProvider, AnthropicProvider, GoogleGeminiProvider } from '../core/external/providers'. In constructor, after externalRegistry instantiation, add: this.openAIProvider = new OpenAIProvider(this.credentialStore); this.anthropicProvider = new AnthropicProvider(this.credentialStore); this.googleGeminiProvider = new GoogleGeminiProvider(this.credentialStore); this.externalRegistry.register(this.openAIProvider); this.externalRegistry.register(this.anthropicProvider); this.externalRegistry.register(this.googleGeminiProvider). Declare readonly fields for these providers.
acceptance_criteria: ProviderTypes.ts exports all shared interfaces with correct TypeScript shapes
OpenAIProvider, AnthropicProvider, GoogleGeminiProvider classes exist and extend BaseExternalProvider
Each provider implements generateStream, validateApiKey, execute methods with real API endpoints
All three providers store/retrieve API keys via CredentialStore with correct service IDs
IntelligenceRegistry has registerExternalProvider and getProvidersByRequirement methods
Built-in provider registration includes all three external providers with benchmark scores and cost/latency profiles
ServiceContainer instantiates and registers all three providers in externalRegistry
npm run typecheck passes without errors
verification: Manually inspect OpenAIProvider.ts, AnthropicProvider.ts, GoogleGeminiProvider.ts for API endpoint URLs and error handling
Manually inspect IntelligenceRegistry.ts for new methods and built-in provider calls
Manually inspect container.ts for provider instantiation and registration
findings: Implementation completed successfully. All three external AI provider adapters (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini) created with full streaming support, API key validation, error mapping (INVALID_KEY, RATE_LIMIT, NETWORK_ERROR), and CredentialStore integration. IntelligenceRegistry extended with registerExternalProvider() and getProvidersByRequirement() methods. All providers registered with benchmark scores (MMLU, HumanEval) and cost/latency profiles in registerBuiltInProviders(). ServiceContainer instantiates and registers all three providers. TypeScript compilation successful for all new provider files. Note: Pre-existing tsconfig.json issue with ignoreDeprecations='6.0' is unrelated to this feature.
